blocks.translation:
• Recommended age for this product is 15 years and older. Do not give to children under the recommended age under any circumstances.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; take care that small children do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking and similar hazards.
• There are sharp and pointed parts; take care when handling and storing. There is a risk of unexpected injury.
• This product uses electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care.
• Do not use near the ears. If used accidentally, there is a risk of hearing damage.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED lights. There is a risk of feeling unwell.
• Improper use of batteries may cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Please observe the following precautions.
• Never use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or batteries of different types.
• Set the +/− (plus-minus) polarity correctly.

ください。
blocks.translation:
• After playing, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or place the batteries in fire.
• If battery leakage liquid gets into the eyes, immediately rinse with plenty of water and consult a physician. If it gets on the skin or clothing, wash with water.

source_blocks.translation: They raised a rebellion against the Space Empire "Zangyack" and, proudly bearing the shame of being pirates, are a bold bunch. Their name is...

source_blocks.text: ゴーカイレッド 海賊戦隊!

source_blocks.translation: Narration: Thirty-four Super Sentai teams that have continued to protect Earth's peace and the smiles of the people.

source_blocks.text: 宇宙帝国 「ザンギャック」 との戦いで失われたその力を受け継いだのは、 とんでもないヤツらだった!
source_blocks.translation: Those who inherited the power lost in the battle with the Space Empire "Zangyack" were a most outrageous bunch!

source_blocks.text: ゴーカイレッド 海賊戦隊!
全員: ゴーカイジャー!
ナビィ デンジャー! デンジャー! デンジャラス!みんなに危険が迫っている!
source_blocks.translation: Navi: Danger! Danger! Dangerous! Danger is approaching everyone!

source_blocks.text: 2 : なんか凄い銀色の男を探すべし。
source_blocks.translation: 2: We should search for some incredible silver-colored man.

source_blocks.text: 3 ゴーカイシルバー: あっ皆さん!ちょっと、 どこ行ってたんですか? 俺ずっと心配したんですからぁ。
source_blocks.translation: 3 Gokai Silver: Oh, everyone! Hey, where have you been? I was worried the whole time!
